messages:
Maya: Quick check: can we scope an alpha for Optimize recs (batching + cache suggestions, quant advice as report, and eval-triggered alerts) to ship in 2 sprints?

Raj: Yes if quant is offline-only (no runtime changes). Recommender + alert plumbing + tiny Console tile.

Lina: We need per-customer gold sets for baseline mismatch, plus telemetry: tokens_saved, p95 delta, eval_mismatch_rate.

ACME-Beth: ACME can provide 500 gold prompts. We want quant recommendations with expected cost/latency numbers, manual review only.

Mateo: Platform asks: feature flag opt-in, webhook endpoint, SDK events for accept/reject. I can deliver flags+webhook in sprint 1.

Priya: Console will be one small card showing top recs and an "accept" button. Mockup Wed.

Jorge: Acceptance checks: <=3% quality regression on gold set, p95 latency delta <= +25ms, tokens_saved >=10% on batched traffic. Hold if fail.

Maya: Action owners: Raj design doc Tue, Mateo flags/webhook Wed, Priya mockups Wed, Lina thresholds Fri, Jorge tests Fri. Thumbs? :thumbsup:

All: +1
